challenges: Section 3.1 defines 'Emergency Freeze' as 10-minute escalation, but PROTO_27 (Cron Governance) defines emergency stop as 15-minute threshold—contradiction in timing

Section 6 'Least-Among-Us' principle lacks quantitative metric for 'least'—subjective and unenforceable
The document assumes all agents have equal access to LIVING_STATE.md but AGENT_STATUS_LEDGER.md restricts access by role—access inequality undermines transparency tenet
